title: HAFixAgent: History-Aware Agentic Program Repair
abstract: arXiv:2511.01047v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Automated program repair (APR) has recently shifted toward large language models and agent-based systems, while prior work shows that repository history can help repair single-line bugs. We conduct a large-scale empirical study of whether, how much, and under what conditions repository history improves agentic APR beyond this setting. We present HAFixAgent, a history-aware program repair agent that injects blame-derived repository context into its repair loop. Across 854 Defects4J (Java) and 501 BugsInPy (Python) bugs, we first show that bug-relevant history is widely available. We then evaluate HAFixAgent across three base models under perfect fault localization. The best history heuristic improves over non-history from +4.4% on Defects4J and +1.1% on BugsInPy with the strongest model to as much as +64.3% with weaker models. HAFixAgent also outperforms RepairAgent by +56.6% and BIRCH-feedback by +47.1% on the strongest model,

translated_title: HAFixAgent：历史感知的智能体化程序修复
translated_abstract: 自动程序修复（APR）近来已转向大语言模型和基于智能体的系统，而先前的研究表明，仓库历史可以帮助修复单行缺陷。我们开展了一项大规模实证研究，探讨在超越这一设定的更广泛场景下，仓库历史是否、在多大程度上以及在何种条件下能够改进基于智能体的APR。我们提出了HAFixAgent，一个历史感知的程序修复智能体，它将基于blame归因分析获得的仓库上下文注入其修复循环中。在854个Defects4J（Java）缺陷和501个BugsInPy（Python）缺陷上，我们首先证明了与缺陷相关的历史信息是广泛可获得的。随后，我们在完美故障定位条件下，基于三种基础模型对HAFixAgent进行了评估。最佳的历史启发式方法相比不使用历史信息的方法，在使用最强模型时在Defects4J上提升+4.4%、在BugsInPy上提升+1.1%，而在较弱模型上提升高达+64.3%。在最强模型上，HAFixAgent还比RepairAgent高出+56.6%，比BIRCH-feedback高出+47.1%。
tldr: HAFixAgent通过将基于git blame归因的仓库历史上下文注入修复循环，显著提升了基于大语言模型的自动程序修复效果，对较弱模型的提升最高达64.3%，并大幅超越RepairAgent和BIRCH-feedback等现有最优智能体方法。
en_tdlr: HAFixAgent injects blame-derived repository history context into the repair loop, substantially improving LLM-based agentic program repair with gains up to 64.3% on weaker models, outperforming state-of-the-art agents like RepairAgent and BIRCH-feedback.
